GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 5 lengths. well back turn hard ridden. Never Likely # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the mare, rider advised that his mount was unsettled in the gates, began awkwardly and did not race genuinely during the race by travelling on and off the bit throughout. He further added that his mount hung out rounding the home turn and did not respond to his riding in the straight. Trainer advised that in his view, today’s performance could be attributed to the mare showing signs of being in season but undertook to report any other condition that might become apparent in the days subsequent.
